lines.speaker: Ollie
lines.text: Look! A big fish in my net!

lines.speaker: Benji
lines.text: Thank you, but we have our own food.

lines.speaker: Fiona
lines.text: We’re here for the meeting. Where is it?

lines.speaker: Ollie
lines.text: On the other side of the lake, next morning.

lines.speaker: Sunny
lines.text: How will we find the place?

lines.speaker: Ollie
lines.text: Look for an old boat beside an old fishing hut.

lines.speaker: Ollie
lines.text: Follow the path by the water.

lines.speaker: Bunny
lines.text: Thank you, Ollie. Enjoy your fish!
